added.summary: <joystick action>, <dpad action> and <button data-og-touch> are input sources of og-input actions: their laid-out rects become the action map's zones, sampled from the touches that started on them in the tick (a stick from its centre past data-dead-zone, a d-pad eight ways, a button while held). @media takes pointer, any-pointer, hover and any-hover.

On-screen control zones (ControlZone: an action, a stick, pad or button kind, a rect in surface CSS px) feed actions as one more binding; session state like the surface, kept across a restore and outside the world hash.
